metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. The three readers are analysis-only, fit on the fixed 256-transition class-balanced subset with W/X's exact optimizer protocol, tuned on the fixed canonical VAL, evaluated once on the untouched canonical TEST. The ONLY factor is the fitting-set size (256 vs W's 10,000). Checkpoint selection is VAL-only; the best-on-TRAIN state is a diagnostic and is never used to select a deployable model; TEST is never used to select or adjust.

primary_decision.rule_note: Y-MIX if the GRU and TCN reach materially different fitting outcomes (one family >=0.90 train, the other not); else Y-A if some GRU/TCN at L4/full reaches >=0.90 training accuracy on the 256-subset AND its held-out Class-A target accuracy (max over the reported states) stays <=0.25; else Y-B if neither sequence reader reaches 0.90 training accuracy at either history condition; else Y-inconclusive. Bars are declared conventions; continuous values reported.
